d: Ramlila Maidan Protest LIVE:The INDIA bloc's mega rally at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan brings together Opposition parties and leaders to raise concerns over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and demand accountability from Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Rahul Gandhi has urged students, civil society groups and citizens to join the rally, calling it a movement to defend democracy and the Constitution. Watch the key moments and voices from the ground.
